title: Update asset/generator.py, qa/critic.py, manager.py — director-era topology

acceptance_criteria_verified.canonical_noop: generate() with kind='canonical' returns ok=True without creating any new SVG file (TestCanonical.test_canonical_no_svg_generated)
acceptance_criteria_verified.produce_canonical_reads_casting: generate() with kind='produce_canonical' reads only casting_data[id].canonical_description (TestProduceCanonical.test_produce_canonical_reads_from_casting_not_scene)
acceptance_criteria_verified.qa_storyboard_uses_opus: critique('storyboard') always uses MODEL_OPUS regardless of budget tier (TestCritiqueStoryboard.test_storyboard_always_uses_opus)

implementation_notes.asset_generator: Dispatches on kind in (canonical, produce_canonical, local, variant). Variant uses SVG wrapper transform (scale+translate+feColorMatrix). No LLM at module level.
implementation_notes.qa_critic: Three levels with distinct prompts and model selection. Offline stub returns PASS when no API key. Critic writes no files (anti-pattern §11.13.7).
implementation_notes.manager: ProjectManager implements §11.9.1 sequence with Python retry counters. --resume diffs raw YAML (not model_dump) to avoid false positives from default field injection. System prompt verbatim from §11.9.2.
